test_title: PYST 05: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the appropriate option that can substitute the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

The entire audience was **__all ears__** when the Indian-born American economist started giving a speech.

options.text: was willing to exit the show
was arguing in favour of both sides

solution: The correct answer is: **was keen to listen**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"all ears"** means very attentive and keen to listen. (सुनने के लिए उत्सुक) • **Example:** When the teacher started explaining the mystery, the students were all ears. • **"was keen to listen"** refers to someone who is very eager and attentive to hear what is being said. (सुनने के लिए उत्सुक) • **Example:** The entire team was keen to listen to the CEO's speech about the company's future plans. • Hence, we can infer that **"was keen to listen"** is the correct substitution for the idiom **"all ears"**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. was keen to listen. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** was eager to speak clearly (स्पष्ट रूप से बोलने के लिए उत्सुक) • **Example:** She was eager to speak clearly in the meeting to avoid any misunderstandings. • **Option 2:** was willing to exit the show (प्रदर्शन से बाहर जाने के लिए तैयार था) • **Example:** The contestant was willing to exit the show if it meant preserving his dignity. • **Option 3:** was arguing in favour of both sides (दोनों पक्षों के पक्ष में तर्क दे रहा था) • **Example:** The mediator was arguing in favour of both sides to reach a fair agreement. 38:Tbe7, The correct answer is: **gave away.**
